name: 道開き
story: The first gate opens to a steady journey.
interpretation: Begin with a simple promise and keep walking it every day.

name: 静心
story: A quiet mind sees the right direction.
interpretation: Take a pause and separate your own wish from outside pressure.

name: 縁結び
story: Sincere words strengthen a valuable connection.
interpretation: Speak plainly and care for the relationship through action.

name: 足元
story: The distant goal must not hide today’s work.
interpretation: Finish the next concrete task before worrying about the whole mountain.

name: 守護
story: Support appears when you honor your values.
interpretation: Accept help while continuing to act with integrity.

name: 実り
story: Patient work is reaching its season of reward.
interpretation: Celebrate the result and keep the habits that made it possible.
